title: The Sunday Read: ‘This Was Trump Pulling a Putin’

sentences.zh: 我叫罗伯特·德拉珀，是《纽约时报杂志》的特约撰稿人。

sentences.en: I'd been listening to various podcasts in the wake of Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 在俄罗斯入侵乌克兰之后，我一直在听各种播客。

sentences.en: One of those was Ezra Klein's show.
sentences.zh: 其中一个就是埃兹拉·克莱因的节目。

sentences.en: Ezra's guest was Dr. Fiona Hill, who'd made a career out of studying authoritarian behavior and worked across multiple presidential administrations,
sentences.zh: 埃兹拉的嘉宾是菲奥娜·希尔博士，她以研究独裁行为为业，曾在多届总统任期内供职，

sentences.en: including Donald Trump's as the in-house Russia expert.
sentences.zh: 其中包括唐纳德·特朗普的政府，担任内部的俄罗斯问题专家。

sentences.en: Putin remains a strategic thinker.
sentences.zh: 普京仍然是一个战略思想家。

sentences.en: He's certainly got strategic goals that he's trying to fulfill, irrespective of whether we might think that those are mad goals, you know, from our perspective.
sentences.zh: 他确实有着自己极力想要实现的战略目标，无论我们从自身角度来看是否认为这些是疯狂的目标，你知道的。

sentences.en: These are goals that he has put forward for quite a period of time, including about Ukraine, but also about the rollback of NATO.
sentences.zh: 这些是他提出相当长一段时间的目标，包括关于乌克兰，也关于北约东退。

sentences.en: And what he sees is some kind of monumental struggle with the United States for Russia's right to exist in the world.
sentences.zh: 在他看来，这与美国之间存在某种历史性斗争，关乎俄罗斯在世界上的生存权。

sentences.en: And he certainly framed it in this way as well.
sentences.zh: 他当然也是这样构建这一叙事的。

sentences.en: I figured that there were ramifications for Ukraine as a result of Trump's disrespectful behavior towards the new Ukrainian president, Volodymyr Zelensky, in 2019.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，2019年特朗普对乌克兰新总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基的不敬行为，必然会给乌克兰带来后续影响。

sentences.en: One likely outcome was the emboldening of the Russian president, Vladimir Putin.
sentences.zh: 一个可能的结果就是助长了俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的嚣张气焰。

sentences.en: But it additionally got me thinking about other things.
sentences.zh: 但这也引发了我对其他事情的思考。

sentences.en: I was at the Capitol on January the 6th, 2021,
sentences.zh: 2021年1月6日我当时就在国会山，

sentences.en: and I realized that there was probably not only a connection between how Trump dealt with Ukraine in 2019 and what's happened in Ukraine since that time,
sentences.zh: 我意识到，不仅特朗普在2019年对待乌克兰的方式与之后乌克兰发生的事情之间存在某种联系，

sentences.en: but also how Trump responded to staving off an impeachment conviction in 2020 and the kind of behavior he exhibited in his efforts to overturn the election.
sentences.zh: 而且特朗普在2020年为逃脱弹劾定罪而做出的反应，以及他在试图推翻选举结果时表现出的那种行为，两者之间也有联系。

sentences.en: So I thought that individuals like Fiona Hill, who had witnessed the president's behavior, would also have some interesting thoughts about January 6th, too.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，像目睹过总统行为的菲奥娜·希尔这样的人，对于1月6日事件也会有一些有趣的见解。

sentences.en: Dr. Fiona Hill is a British-born,
sentences.zh: 菲奥娜·希尔博士是一位出生于英国、

sentences.en: naturalized American citizen who became the national intelligence officer specializing in Russia and Eurasia for the Bush administration and then for the first year of the Obama administration.
sentences.zh: 加入美国国籍的公民，曾担任小布什政府以及奥巴马政府第一年期间的国家情报委员会俄罗斯和欧亚事务国家情报官。

sentences.en: It was already becoming clear to members of the Trump administration that the new president had a rather peculiar affinity for Vladimir Putin and that it would therefore be important to have a kind of in-house counterweight to whatever Putin said and did.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府的成员当时已经开始意识到，这位新总统对弗拉基米尔·普京有着某种奇特的喜爱，因此必须在内部为普京的言行建立某种制衡机制，这一点至关重要。

sentences.en: And that, therefore, was the arrangement through which he joined the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，她才得以通过这样的安排加入了特朗普政府。

sentences.en: Hill never quite developed the sort of relationship with Trump that was supposed to be part of her job description.
sentences.zh: 希尔并没有与特朗普建立起那种本该属于她职责范围的关系。

sentences.en: They just never hit it off.
sentences.zh: 他们俩就是合不来。

sentences.en: The president was more impressed by his secretary of state, Rex Tillerson, because, after all, Tillerson was a billionaire, former CEO of ExxonMobil, and in that capacity had,
sentences.zh: 总统对他的国务卿雷克斯·蒂勒森印象更深，因为蒂勒森毕竟是亿万富翁、埃克森美孚的前CEO，以这个身份，

sentences.en: so heard Trump, cut major deals with Putin.
sentences.zh: 据特朗普所说，曾与普京达成过重大交易。

sentences.en: And Hill, by contrast, was this academic.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，希尔只是个学者。

sentences.en: That was the kind of credential that meant very little to President Trump.
sentences.zh: 这种资历对特朗普总统来说微不足道。

sentences.en: In 2020, Putin changed the Russian Constitution to allow him to serve additional terMs.
sentences.zh: 2020年，普京修改了俄罗斯宪法，允许他延长任期。

sentences.en: And so, on January 6th, Trump was basically attempting the same thing, saying, in effect,
sentences.zh: 因此，在1月6日，特朗普基本上是在效仿这一做法，实际上是在说：

sentences.en: election results be damned under the pretext of my baseless belief that the election was stolen.
sentences.zh: 选举结果去他的吧，借口是我毫无根据地认定选举被窃取了。

sentences.en: I'm going to stay in power.
sentences.zh: 我要继续掌权。

sentences.en: In the years before the Trump presidency, but certainly in the wake of his presidency, the faith that Americans have in all our major institutions, governmental and otherwise,
sentences.zh: 在特朗普总统任期之前数年，尤其是经历了其总统任期之后，美国人对所有主要机构（无论是政府还是其他机构）的信任，

sentences.en: is being eroded by anti-democratic sentiments.
sentences.zh: 正在被反民主情绪侵蚀。

sentences.en: We're at this moment in time when a significant majority of self-identified Republicans believe, against evidence to the contrary, that the 2020 election was stolen.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于这样一个时刻：绝大多数自认为属于共和党的人都深信2020年大选被窃取了，尽管证据确凿并非如此。

sentences.en: With all of what's taken place, we can see that though President Trump didn't succeed in overturning the 2020 election, that he essentially created a playbook,
sentences.zh: 经历了这一切，我们可以看到，尽管特朗普总统未能成功推翻2020年大选，但他实际上创造了一本剧本，

sentences.en: showed a pathway for someone perhaps more skilled, less prone to self-immolation, to pull that off.
sentences.zh: 为某个可能更有手腕、更不容易自我毁灭的人开辟了一条成功复制此事的道路。

sentences.en: So, having heard those concerns expressed by others, and frankly, having felt a lot of them myself, I contacted Dr. Hill and said I wanted to do a story about Trump, Russia,
sentences.zh: 因此，在听取了其他人表达的这些担忧，坦率地说，自己也深有同感之后，我联系了希尔博士，说我想写一篇关于特朗普、俄罗斯、

sentences.en: and Ukraine, in which she would be a prominent character.
sentences.zh: 以及乌克兰的故事，而她将是其中的核心人物。

sentences.en: A week later, I traveled to Colorado, where she was doing a lecture series, asked if I could tag along, because I wanted to hear what people were asking her about,
sentences.zh: 一周后，我前往科罗拉多州，当时她正在那里进行系列讲座，我询问是否可以随行，因为我想听听人们都在向她询问什么，

sentences.en: and what she had to say, and she said yes.
sentences.zh: 以及她会说些什么，她答应了。

sentences.en: So, here's my article.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是我的文章。

sentences.zh: 菲奥娜·希尔清晰地记得她第一次走进椭圆形办公室，与总统讨论棘手的乌克兰问题的场景。

sentences.zh: 那是2008年2月，乔治·W·

sentences.zh: 布什政府的最后一年。

sentences.zh: 当时担任国家情报委员会俄罗斯和欧亚事务国家情报官的希尔，

sentences.zh: 被召集参加关于即将在罗马尼亚布加勒斯特召开的北约峰会的战略会议。

sentences.en: Among the matters up for discussion was the possibility of Ukraine and another former Soviet state, Georgia, beginning the process of obtaining NATO membership.
sentences.zh: 讨论的事项之一是乌克兰和另一个前苏联加盟共和国格鲁吉亚开始获得北约成员国资格进程的可能性。

sentences.en: In the Oval Office, Hill recalls, describing a scene that has not been previously reported,
sentences.zh: 希尔回忆说，在椭圆形办公室里——这一场景此前从未被报道过——

sentences.en: she told Bush and Vice President Dick Cheney that offering a membership path to Ukraine and Georgia could be problematic.
sentences.zh: 她对布什和副总统迪克·切尼表示，为乌克兰和格鲁吉亚提供加入北约的途径可能会带来问题。

sentences.en: While Bush's appetite for promoting the spread of democracy had not been dampened by the Iraq War,
sentences.zh: 虽然布什推动民主传播的热情并未因伊拉克战争而减弱，

sentences.en: President Vladimir Putin of Russia viewed NATO with suspicion and was vehemently opposed to neighboring countries joining its ranks.
sentences.zh: 但俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京对北约抱有戒心，并强烈反对邻国加入北约。

sentences.en: He would regard it as a provocation, which was one reason the United States' key NATO allies opposed the idea.
sentences.zh: 他会认为这是一种挑衅，这也是美国关键北约盟友反对这一想法的原因之一。

sentences.en: Cheney took umbrage at Hill's assessment.
sentences.zh: 切尼对希尔的评估感到十分不满。

sentences.en: So you're telling me you're opposed to freedom and democracy, she says he snapped.
sentences.zh: 所以你是说你反对自由和民主咯？据她说，切尼厉声说道。

sentences.en: According to Hill, he abruptly gathered his materials and walked out of the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 据希尔回忆，他气冲冲地收拾好材料，走出了椭圆形办公室。

sentences.en: He's just yanking your chain, she remembers Bush telling her.
sentences.zh: 他只是在逗你玩呢，她记得布什对她说。

sentences.zh: 继续说你刚才的话。

sentences.zh: 情报界的建议，

sentences.zh: 希尔的预言应验了。

sentences.en: It was the worst of all possible worlds, Hill said to me in her austere English accent as she recalled the episode over lunch this March.
sentences.zh: 今年3月，她一边吃午餐，一边带着她那严谨的英国口音回忆起这段插曲，对我说道：“那是所有可能结果中最糟糕的一个。”

sentences.en: As one of the foremost experts on Putin and a current unofficial advisor to the Biden administration on the Russia-Ukraine war,
sentences.zh: 作为普京研究领域的顶尖专家之一，同时也是拜登政府关于俄乌战争的非官方现任顾问，
